Fit one forest model and return its tidy rows

Source: R/forestPlot.R
INTERNAL_forest_fit_one.Rd

Fit one forest model and return its tidy rows

Usage

.forest_fit_one(data, model, covs, time, status, outcome, conf.level)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

model

One of "cox", "logistic" or "linear".

covs

The covariates in this model.

time, status

For model = "cox", the follow-up time column and the event column. The event column may be 0/1 (1 = event), 1/2 (2 = event, the survival::Surv() convention), logical, or a factor/character with an event label such as "dead".

outcome

For "logistic", a binary outcome column (0/1, logical, or a two-level factor/character whose second level is the event); for "linear", a numeric outcome column.

conf.level

Confidence level for the intervals.

Value

A data frame as described in .forest_estimates().
